column4: 割り込みイベント　追加分なので短めで良いです
column5: Interrupt event: since it is an addition, it can be brief.

column4: その頃・・　マルグリッド迷宮
column5: Meanwhile... in the Marguerite Labyrinth.

column4: 魔物兵を叩き斬るダークランス
column5: Dark Rance slashes through monster soldiers.

column4: よし、これであいつが踏破してきたのと同じ階だな
column5: Alright, now this is the same floor that guy reached.

column4: はい、さようで・・と案内役のハニー（雇われ道案内）
column5: Yes, that's correct... says Hanny, the guide (a hired guide).

column4: 次の階に進みますか？
column5: Shall we proceed to the next floor?

column4: いや、いい、あいつと同じ場所までこれたらそれでいい
column5: No, it's fine. As long as I can reach the same place as that guy, that's enough.

column4: よし、と、メモを取り出して踏破した所に×印を付ける・・
column5: Alright, then, I take out my notes and mark an X where I have cleared...

column4: 後少しだな、今に見てろ
column5: Just a little more. Just you wait.

column4: 回想ぽく
column5: (Like a flashback)

column4: あの男を倒し、かぁさんを助け出す
column5: Defeat that man and rescue my mother.

column4: しかし、あの男は、幾多の冒険を経た強者だ、今の俺ではかなわない
column5: But that man is a strong warrior who has experienced many adventures; I can't beat him as I am now.

column4: 圧倒的な経験の差だ
column5: It's an overwhelming difference in experience.

column4: 追いつくためには、俺も同じ経験を積めばいい
column5: To catch up, I just need to gain the same experience.

column4: あの男が踏破した迷宮、倒したモンスター、全てクリアして越えてやる。
column5: I will clear and surpass every labyrinth that man traversed and every monster he defeated.

column4: あれから・・１年
column5: Since then... one year has passed.

column4: ・・・キエン屋敷
column5: ...Khien Mansion

column4: 幽霊がなんだ、もう慣れたぞ
column5: Ghosts? I've already gotten used to them.

column4: ・・・リーザスのコロシアム
column5: ...Leazas Coliseum

column4: あいつも優勝したが、俺も優勝した
column5: That guy won too, but I also won the championship.

column4: ・・・ハイパービル
column5: ...Hyperville

column4: 最上階まで階段を使って制覇してやった
column5: I conquered it by climbing the stairs all the way to the top floor.

column4: ・・・玄武城
column5: ...Genbu Castle

column4: 閉じ込められていた女の子を助けたが代わりに
column5: I saved the girl who was trapped, but in return...

column4: 数年出られなくなったが、いい修業だった
column5: I couldn't get out for several years, but it was good training.

column4: ・・・イラーピュの墜落地点に出来た迷宮
column5: ...The labyrinth built at the crash site of Irapyu.

column4: ・・・地下帝国ブハード跡地
column5: ...Ruins of the Underground Empire Buhard.

column4: ・・・ゼスのいくつかの迷宮
column5: ...Several labyrinths in Zeth.

column4: ・・・ヘルマンのいくつかの迷宮
column5: ...Several labyrinths in Helman.

column4: ・・・カイズ地下
column5: ...Kaiz underground.

column4: ・・・八甲田山、死国
column5: ...Mount Hakkoda, Land of the Dead.

column4: などなど、いっぱいクリアしてきた
column5: And so on, I've cleared a lot.

column4: 友も得たし、ライバルとも戦った、後・・女の子と・・手も繋いだ
column5: I've made friends, fought rivals, and also... held hands with a girl.

column4: よし、次にいこう。
column5: Alright, let's move on to the next.

column4: ダークランスの持つ宝剣グラムが輝いた
column5: The treasured sword Gram, held by Dark Rance, shone brightly.

column4: そういや、昔もらったこの剣、だいぶ大きくなったな。
column5: Come to think of it, this sword I got long ago has grown quite a bit.

column4: （　このあたり、伏線として必要なら入れて、グラムの事　）
column5: (If needed as foreshadowing around here, include something about Gram.)

column4: 産まれた歳のイベント
column5: Event from the year it was born.

column4: 珍しいので三魔子（サンマシ）のレガシオに謁見される。
column5: Because it was rare, it was presented to the Sanmashi's (Three Demonic Children) Legasio.

column4: 悲しみや怒りの感情で攻撃力が上がる武器です。名前は『グラム』
column5: It is a weapon that increases attack power with feelings of sadness and anger. Its name is 'Gram'.

column4: 貰えた理由は三魔子謁見での「いい目をしている」といった少年漫画王道パターン。
column5: The reason it was given was the classic shonen manga trope of 'You have good eyes,' during the audience with the Sanmashi.

column4: 生まれた経緯が経緯なので呼ばれた時に渡されました。
column5: Because of the circumstances of its birth, it was handed over when summoned.
